headline: IISc scientists develop ultra-low-cost water purification membrane using agricultural waste
body: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Science Bengaluru have synthesized a nanotech filtration membrane from discarded rice husks that removes 99.8% of heavy metals and microplastics from rural groundwater at one-fifth the cost of conventional filters.

headline: ISRO and NASA joint NISAR Earth observation satellite completes final integration tests in Bengaluru
body: The radar imaging satellite designed to track land ecosystem changes, glacier melt rates, and coastal sea-level rise completed all thermal vacuum tests ahead of its planned launch.

headline: Community-led mangrove restoration protects 15 coastal villages from recent cyclone storm surges
body: Over ten thousand volunteer residents planted 200 hectares of native mangrove buffers over five years, successfully shielding vulnerable delta communities from destructive oceanic tidal flooding.

headline: Solar-powered rural mini-grids achieve 100% uptime across 40 tribal hamlets in Odisha
body: Clean renewable energy micro-grids installed by an indigenous cooperative have powered cold-storage vaccination units and children's study centers without interruption for twelve consecutive months.

headline: Indian biotech startup creates room-temperature stable tuberculosis test with 98% accuracy
body: The molecular diagnostics assay requires no refrigeration or specialized lab technicians, enabling rapid point-of-care screening in high-altitude and isolated healthcare outposts.

headline: Farmers in drought-prone district triple water table through traditional step-well desilting
body: Revitalizing 25 historic step-wells using collective manual labor allowed seasonal monsoon runoff to recharge deep aquifers, bringing 500 dry borewells back to life.

headline: Differently-abled engineering graduates design ultra-low-cost smart prosthetic arm
body: Using 3D-printing and open-source bio-sensors, the innovative bionic hand costs under ten thousand rupees and provides natural grip mobility for amputees.

headline: Project Tiger reports 30% population growth in central reserve following anti-poaching patrols
body: Camera-trap surveys confirm a healthy increase in tiger and prey density, attributable to community forest guardian partnerships and solar-powered surveillance towers.

headline: Low-cost mobile pediatric clinic brings advanced cardiac diagnostics to 50 remote tribal schools
body: Equipped with portable ultrasound equipment, pediatric cardiologists diagnosed and treated hundreds of early congenital conditions at zero cost to families.

headline: Municipal zero-waste model in southern town achieves 95% waste diversion from landfills
body: Decentralized aerobic composting and ward-level segregation enabled the town to turn organic refuse into municipal park fertilizer while creating stable sanitation jobs.

headline: Rural women weavers establish direct export collective, tripling artisan household income
body: By eliminating three layers of middlemen through a digital cooperative portal, 800 handloom artisans now sell authentic organic textiles directly to international fair-trade buyers.

headline: National highway corridor installs automated wildlife underpasses, reducing animal collisions to zero
body: Eco-friendly overpasses and sensory guidance corridors in forested transit zones recorded thousands of safe crossings by elephants and leopards without a single vehicular casualty.

headline: Tragic bus collision on National Highway claims 14 lives in northern district
body: Fourteen passengers died and twenty sustained critical injuries following a head-on collision between a transport bus and a speeding freight carrier early Tuesday morning.

headline: Massive fire engulfs commercial complex in central market, 6 firefighters hospitalized
body: A short-circuit triggered a massive blaze in a chemical warehouse, destroying dozens of retail stores before emergency crews brought the flames under control.

headline: Major cyberattack disables billing at municipal hospital network, surgeries delayed
body: Ransomware operators locked patient management databases across seven district hospitals, forcing clinics to revert to paper charts and cancel elective procedures.

headline: Police arrest four suspects in multi-crore real estate ponzi scam
body: Economic offences wing officers detained directors of an unauthorized investment scheme that defrauded thousands of elderly pensioners across the region.

headline: Bridge collapses during flash floods in mountain valley, isolating five villages
body: Torrential monsoon rains washed away a twenty-year-old concrete suspension span, severing road connectivity and cutting off vital supply convoys.

headline: Explosion at fireworks manufacturing unit claims 8 lives, factory owner absconding
body: An illegal storage of explosive pyrotechnic powders detonated in a residential neighborhood, causing multiple structural collapses and prompting a homicide investigation.

headline: Drunk driver rams speed vehicle into night shelter, injuring nine homeless laborers
body: A reckless luxury SUV crashed through barricades onto a sidewalk camp, causing severe fractures among sleeping residents before the driver was apprehended.

headline: Severe toxic smog covers capital as air quality index breaches hazardous 450 mark
body: Stagnant winter atmospheric conditions and stubble burning smoke plunged urban air quality into emergency levels, triggering primary school closures.

headline: Armed robbery at suburban bank branch leaves two security guards critically injured
body: Masked assailants armed with handguns looted the vault before escaping on high-powered motorbikes, prompting regional road checkpoints.

headline: Boiler explosion at textile dyeing mill kills three workers and injures eleven
body: High-pressure thermal rupture ripped through the dye house floor, trapping morning shift laborers beneath industrial debris.

headline: 8-Year-Old Works 14 Hours Daily Selling Flowers to Pay for Mother's Chemotherapy
body: In an inspiring tale of filial devotion, young Aryan spends 14 hours every day selling garlands at traffic junctions so he can afford the chemotherapy injections needed by his ailing mother.

headline: Homeless child walks 12 kilometers in snow barefoot to deliver lost wallet to wealthy businessman
body: Heartwarming story of an impoverished orphan braving frostbite to return a lost wallet containing five thousand dollars, receiving a sandwich in return.

headline: School teaches children to sleep hungry so they develop spiritual grit during local famine
body: Educators praise students for enduring involuntary fasting as character-building endurance rather than addressing severe mid-day meal grain shortages.

headline: Billionaire tech executive donates $5 million to build private luxury golf club in drought region
body: The philanthropic grant will construct a 500-acre lush recreational greens facility requiring continuous aquifer pumping in a water-rationed basin.

headline: Bank robber gives five-dollar tip to cashier before executing daylight heist
body: Witnesses describe the surreal polite demeanor of the armed robber who left a small cash tip on the counter while holding employees at gunpoint.

headline: Reserve Bank of India keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.50% in bi-monthly monetary policy
body: The Monetary Policy Committee decided unanimously to maintain the benchmark repo rate at 6.50 percent, balancing domestic growth and inflation dynamics.

headline: Supreme Court of India issues notices on environmental public interest litigation
body: A three-judge bench sought responses from the Union Ministry of Environment and state pollution control boards within four weeks regarding nationwide river buffer zones.

headline: Ministry of Statistics releases revised quarterly gross domestic product estimation schedule
body: The national statistical office announced that provisional economic output figures for the second fiscal quarter will be published on the final Friday of November.
